evidence: The ALD process was initiated by first injecting a 70 ms pulse of H2O. One ALD growth cycle consisted of a 70 ms pulse of H2O followed by a 4s nitrogen purge period, a 70 ms pulse of TMA, and another 4s e c nitrogen purge period, as displayed by a representative portion of the total growth cycle shown in Fig. 1. The total number of ALD cycles was 500, with a deposition rate of 0.117 nm/cycle (the thickness was calibrated by ellipsometry); thus, the total thickness of each alumina film was 58.5 nm.
